description: Account number field stored as int64 but represents a 4‑digit identifier; all 30 values are non‑null, with 28 distinct values and two duplicated entries (1001, 1010). Values range from 1001 to 1028 and are uniformly four characters long.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert numeric values to string format for 100% of records, e.g., 1026 → '1026'.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values conform to a four‑digit string pattern, e.g., '1026'.
